recognize_zh: 中央一顆淋巴球，核濃縮、細胞質中等偏淡藍，細胞質周邊散布幾顆粗大的粉紫色顆粒；這種有顆粒的淋巴球即大顆粒淋巴球（LGL），是 NK 細胞增多的形態線索。
features: Medium-sized lymphocyte with moderate N:C ratio
Round nucleus with dense, clumped chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Discrete coarse azurophilic granules scattered at the cytoplasmic periphery
Normochromic red cells and scattered platelets; no blasts in field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows unremarkable normochromic red cells with scattered platelets. The field contains a medium-sized lymphocyte with mature, condensed chromatin and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm containing a few coarse azurophilic granules. There are no blasts, nucleated red cells, or dysplastic features in this field. Findings are consistent with a large granular lymphocyte, supporting NK-cell lymphocytosis when an absolute LGL increase is documented; lineage and clonality require flow cytometry and molecular studies.

ddx.vs: Same LGL morphology; T-LGL is CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ with clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas NK cells are surface CD3-negative with CD16/CD56 expression.
Reactive lymphocytes show abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells and typically lack discrete azurophilic granules.
A neutrophil has a segmented nucleus and pink cytoplasm diffusely filled with granules rather than a round nucleus with a few discrete granules.
